name: Protein Wafer Dark Chocolate
ingredients_raw: Protein Blend (Fermented Yeast Protein + Milk Solids), Sweetener (Maltitol), Multigrain Blend (Whole Wheat Flour (Atta), Jowar), Coconut Oil, Edible Hydrogenated Coconut Fat, Cocoa Solids (4.8%), Nature Identical Flavours & Flavouring Substances, Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin), Maize Starch, Edible Common Salt, Improver Enzyme.
